title: Using GenAI Tools to Edit Faster
author: Maya Rao
summary: How to use GenAI assistants to tidy text, check consistency and draft summaries, while still reviewing every result.
image_alt: Illustration of a person reviewing text suggested by an AI assistant
body: GenAI tools can suggest cleaner wording, shorter summaries and consistent terminology.
Always review the output: tools can miss context or introduce mistakes.
Good prompts state the audience, the tone and the length you want.
